exposure.needed: whether any dashboards, alerts or recording rules query the metric doublewrite_identity_crd_only_count

assertion.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0 the metric doublewrite_identity_crd_only_count was renamed to doublewrite_identity_crd_only_total. Whether an environment is affected depends on monitoring queries outside the product's configuration.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The subject is a Prometheus metric name, and no subject family (crd-field, helm-value, config-key, protocol-behavior, api-endpoint, and so on) fits a metric without bending its definition.; change: The evidence says the metric was renamed, but a renamed change needs a typed subject and a replacedBy of the same family, and no family fits a metric name.; consequence: The evidence states only the rename. It does not say what happens to queries or alerts that use the old metric name.
